display_long_description:
Modelize Home makes property visualization simple so you can be immersed in the details that matter. Whether you’re a homeowner, CGI artist, developer, architect or sales agent-step into a future home before it's even built and see dreams realized in real time.
Modelize Home enables you to explore immersive spaces created from your floor plans or property models, ensuring your vision is communicated effectively and managed seamlessly. Available on any device, Modelize Home allows you to access your projects wherever you are, empowering you to make decisions on the go.
 
Use Modelize Home to:
 
•	Explore immersive virtual spaces: See your future home come to life in walkable, clickable and dollhouse views.
•	Collaborate and review: Make design reviews a breeze with real-time, in-experience, design review tools.
•	Share your experience: Instantly share your space with family, friends and contractors so they can better understand your future home.
•	Present your space: Easily connect with local and international clients in public and guided viewing sessions. 

Step into a new era of property visualization with Modelize Home and transform how you interact with unbuilt property.
